gloss: skillful; efficient; deft; having good technique

definitions.gloss: skillful; efficient; deft; adept at handling tasks
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who performs tasks quickly, smoothly, and competently. Emphasizes practical skill and efficiency in execution rather than innate talent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手際|てぎわ}が{良|よ}い。
⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}して→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{予定|よてい}{通|どお}り→予定通り：15290_yoteidoori⟧{始|はじ}められた。
examples.english: Thanks to the staff efficiently setting up the venue, we were able to start on schedule.

notes:
⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧ means "skill in handling" or "dexterity" — from ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + {際|ぎわ} (manner, edge). The expression praises someone's practical ability to get things done smoothly.

USAGE:
Often used adverbially as ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (efficiently, deftly) to modify verbs. The negative ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ describes clumsy or inefficient work. Common in cooking, work, and service contexts.

- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧ — to tidy up efficiently
- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to cook deftly
- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ — clumsy, inefficient
- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{良|よ}さ — efficiency, deftness
